duration.basis: fraction of team training-match weight from before the first observed absence
duration.cohort: exact eligible B1 matches for this club; a match counts as exposed only after observed onset
duration.unavailable: retain full duration factor and label unavailable training exposure

3ff85504f692d3928f14f2b20954b88d0fafd8d5.effect_basis: fixed untrained positional effect times absence probability, duration and observed minutes/starts
3ff85504f692d3928f14f2b20954b88d0fafd8d5.evaluation: paired four-component proper score, round-clustered, two horizons

importance.directory_basis: mean of minutes/(90*completed EPL matches) and starts/completed EPL matches
importance.lineup_basis: share of prior completed EPL matches with a confirmed start
importance.neutral_basis: predeclared squad-average prior (11 regular starters among about 27.5 players)

3ff85504f692d3928f14f2b20954b88d0fafd8d5.returns: restore typical lineup, no additional positive effect
